title: PLANIMETRIC
summary: Held frames — locked-off depth planes where background routine and deviation meet. Select fixed, planimetric views of rooms and workspaces with practical activities at different depths. Hold the frame while foreground and background tasks interact and a small route change alters the arrangement, without cutting to a rescuing close-up. Cut across 4 verified public-domain archival windows (41.5s) and audited across two Critic Tribunal rounds (v1 → v2).

reviews.text:
VERDICT: repair_required (Round 1 — v1 assembly audit)
Critic Role: Independent tableau critic

Observed Defects on v1 Proof Strip:
- Seg #02 (t=03.50s-14.00s): `8d2b2cbb` (`Long Distance`, 1941) cuts internally at t=05.5s from switchboard operators to 1940s trucks on a highway.
- Seg #05 (t=32.00s-42.00s): `8d2b2cbb` at in_s=14.0s dissolves across forest linemen, a close-up operator, and a moving bus.

Largest Gap:
The primary constraint of `PLANIMETRIC`—a sustained, locked-off fixed view of a room without camera movement or cuts—was violated by internal montage cuts in `8d2b2cbb`.

Causal Hypothesis:
`Long Distance` (`8d2b2cbb`) is a promotional montage with cuts every 2-3 seconds.

Falsifiable Repair Condition:
Replace Seg #02 and Seg #05 with Cineosis human-verified locked-off planimetric room shots: `79565922` (`Working Together`, 1951, `10.2s-19.7s` in Seg #02 and `19.7s-28.4s` in Seg #05, showing the same frontal conference room as posture and table geometry shift across time), paired with `3533825c` (`White Ammunition`, 1942 workshop) and `780c159d` (`Success in Business`, `0.5s-10.0s`, locked-off frontal room tableau).

Strength to Preserve:
Tableau 02 (`3533825c`, `White Ammunition`, 1942) and the locked-off conference room tableau (`79565922`, `Working Together`, 1951).
